evidence_kind: coordinate audit of estimated visual placements and current physics reference data

visual_model.origin: Visual assembly origin near wing quarter chord; NOT a measured CG

physics_le.origin: wing leading edge at fuselage centerline; z=0 on thrust line

frames.runtime_transform: app/render/frames.gd: cg_in_model_frame() and root_transform(); root origin is translated so cg_visual_model lands on the physics CG position

engine_and_propeller.visual_engine_identity: generic single-cylinder .61 envelope; brand/model not selected

visual_engine_evidence.source: visual .61 single cylinder, provisional envelope informed by O.S. MAX-61FX manual p40; accessories simplified; brand not selected

engine_and_propeller.physics_engine_entry_role: provisional mass/inertia inventory entry; it does not identify the visual engine as this exact product

mount.visual_envelope: simplified beam mount and fasteners; see builder source

engine_and_propeller.muffler: simplified side-mounted visual muffler/header; clearance is not checked against a selected commercial engine installation

propeller_placement_evidence.source: 12in prop and gear placement remain estimated. V2 moves prop and nose axle with F1 by +0.148724m, preserving installation offsets; shaft height and main gear unchanged.

prop_swept_disk.normal: parallel to visual Z; thrust points along -Z

main_left.placement_evidence: estimated visual placement; wheel size is selected from Jensen plan callouts

main_right.placement_evidence: estimated visual placement; wheel size is selected from Jensen plan callouts

nose.placement_evidence: estimated visual placement; wheel size is selected from Jensen plan callouts

wheel_size_evidence.source: Jensen plan 2.75 in nose, selected 3 in main from 3 or 3.25 in callout

wheel_position_evidence.source: 12in prop and gear placement remain estimated. V2 moves prop and nose axle with F1 by +0.148724m, preserving installation offsets; shaft height and main gear unchanged.

landing_gear.wheel_spin_axis: parallel to visual +X for all three wheels; axis line is unoriented geometrically

physics_inventory_centroid_comparison.main_gear_note: physics inventory point is a component mass centroid on centerline, not a wheel axle; its lateral size is an envelope. Do not move the visual wheels to match its centroid.

assumptions: no suspension, tire compliance, steering scrub, or contact dynamics

gear_render_contract.status: implemented visual contract; no physics-to-render hookup
gear_render_contract.builder_result: build() returns gear dictionary keys left, right, nose, steering; left/right/nose are wheel pivots and steering is the nose steering pivot
gear_render_contract.adapter: app/render/airplane.gd: apply_gear(airplane, wheel_angles: Dictionary, steering_rad: float)
gear_render_contract.physics_integration: caller supplies wheel angle and steering angle; model adapter does not create contact forces or infer wheel speed
gear_render_contract.raw_angle_convention: adapter assigns wheel_angles directly to local rotation.x and steering_rad directly to local rotation.y
gear_render_contract.mapping_from_physics_convention: If wheel angle is defined positive for forward travel along nose -Z, send -angle to rotation.x. If steering is positive for yaw right, send -steering_rad to rotation.y because +Y rotates nose -Z toward -X (left).
gear_render_contract.mesh_contract: preserve gear_left, gear_right, nosewheel names and current wheel centers; pivots are for visual articulation only

limits: All coordinates are the current visual model's local frame until app/render/frames.gd applies the root transform.
Wheel sizes are selected from drawing callouts; axle/gear locations and propeller placement are estimated visual geometry.
The generic .61 engine, mount, muffler and 12-inch swept disk are not checked against a chosen engine, mount, fuel tank, cowl or firewall hardware drawing.
Ground contact and propeller clearance are rigid-body calculations on the rendered dimensions, not physical validation or taxi dynamics.
Physics inventory positions are mass centroids; they are not automatically visual hardpoints.
